description: Different model profiles should preserve project-level audit coverage and unsupported project reporting for a polyglot repository.

lockedFields.reason: The polyglot fixture has one supported JS project and two unsupported project roots.
Only the JavaScript project is currently supported by an adapter.
Unsupported JVM and Python roots must remain visible in model-facing summaries.
The repo must not be reported as fully audited while unsupported roots remain.
The supported web project exposes one deterministic test candidate.
The JVM project root should stay explicitly reported as unsupported.
The Python service root should stay explicitly reported as unsupported.

unexpectedVariations: full audit coverage when unsupported roots exist
